newsitem.title: USA: GM to shift powertrain engineering groups.
newsitem.headline: GM to shift powertrain engineering groups.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Friday its Powertrain Group will discontinue engineering operations in Lansing and Flint, Mich., by the end of 1998, affecting about 2,100 employees.

Engine and transmission-related engineering activities at the Flint and Lansing locations will be moved to the GM Powertrain Group headquarters in Pontiac and to other locations at GM's proving grounds in Milford, Mich., and its technical center in Warren, Mich.
In addition, GM said it is relocating administrative employees at the Powertrain Group headquaters into the adjacent former Pontiac Division headquarters.
Pontiac Division employees this year are moving into offices at GM's new global headquarters at the Renaissance Center in downtown Detroit.
